steps.label: Paddy — caryopsis
lines: a one-seeded dry fruit in which the pericarp
is fused with the seed coat.
steps.why: Naming the fruit TYPE beside the plant shows the classification is known - caryopsis is the cereal fruit with pericarp and seed coat fused.
common_mistakes: Calling the rice grain a seed. It is a complete fruit - the caryopsis.
steps.memory_tip: Every cereal grain is a caryopsis - fruit wall and seed coat stuck together.
steps.margin_note: Plant + fruit-type name; the fused-coat line shows understanding.

steps.why: The cashew nut is the true fruit of the cashew plant - one seed inside a hard pericarp - the second named example.
common_mistakes: Writing coconut as a nut. Coconut is a drupe; cashew is the standard nut example.
steps.memory_tip: Cashew - the nut sitting on a false-fruit stalk.
